speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are experiencing fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes. These symptoms are concerning for a significant underlying condition; to begin our investigation, have you had any recent fevers, and what is your medical history regarding tuberculosis or recent travel?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for confirming those symptoms. Given the "B symptoms" (fever, night sweats, weight loss) combined with supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, I am particularly concerned about lymphoma or tuberculosis. Have you noticed if the pain in your abdomen is constant or comes and goes, and has it radiated anywhere?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: The description of fixed, painless supraclavicular nodes is highly suspicious for malignancy. To differentiate between lymphoma and other causes, I need to assess your constitutional symptoms and perform a physical exam. Have you experienced any recent fevers or chills, and when was your last meal? Also, please let me know if you have any skin lesions or changes in your blood count. REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential, LDH, ESR.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Complete Blood Count: WBC - Elevated, Hemoglobin - Slightly Decreased, Platelets - Normal; Lactate Dehydrogenase - Elevated; Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR) - Not Provided.

speaker: Patient
text: I also feel fullness in my abdomen and my clothes feel tighter. I do not have cough or recent travel.

speaker: Patient
text: I have smoked about one pack a day for many years, and I drink socially. The abdominal discomfort and fatigue have both been getting worse. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Lymphoma (likely Hodgkin Lymphoma given supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, B symptoms, and smoking history).
